description: This PHP source file defines the class OpenIDConnectClient which extends a third-party OpenID client class. It implements functionality for redirecting to and retrieving the authentication URL, and managing session attributes related to user authentication within an OpenID Connect context, utilizing a trait for user attribute management.

classes.name: OpenIDConnectClient
classes.description: A client class for handling OpenID Connect authentication, extending a third-party OpenID client and integrating with OrangeHRM's user attribute management.

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Stores the URL to redirect the user for authentication.

methods.name: commitSession
methods.description: Intended to commit session data but currently empty.

methods.name: setSessionKey
methods.description: Sets a session attribute in the authenticated user.

methods.name: getSessionKey
methods.description: Retrieves a session attribute from the authenticated user.

methods.name: unsetSessionKey
methods.description: Removes a session attribute from the authenticated user.
